200.description: Your active logs as a downloadable attachment.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment with filename tadoku-logs.csv or tadoku-logs.json.

logs.description: Active logs ordered by created_at and id, oldest first.

items.description: CSV columns follow the property order listed here.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp as RFC 3339 in UTC, including fractional seconds when present.

amount.description: Recorded amount; null for time-only logs.

unit_name.description: Amount unit display name; null when there is no amount.

duration_seconds.description: Recorded duration in seconds, or null when absent.

score.description: Computed score when present, otherwise the legacy score.

tags.description: Alphabetically sorted tags; CSV joins these with comma and space.

description.description: Log description, or null when absent.

items.title: LogExportEntry
